liz: Anyone know where to find the SLO uptime report for the dedicated GPU pool? We got a burn-rate alert last night for `dedicated-pool-io` and need to check if it was a false positive :eyes:
observability-bot: ALERT fired: `slo_burnrate_dedicated_pool_io_v2` - burn_rate > 3x for 1h. Link: https://observability.redwood.internal/alerts/1795123456
sam: Grafana dashboard is here: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/slo-overview/dedicated?var-policy=dedicated-pool-io
Also check this PromQL for burnout windows:
```
sum(rate(slo_error_total{policy="dedicated-pool-io"}[5m]))
/
sum(rate(slo_total_requests{policy="dedicated-pool-io"}[5m]))
```
maria: That's the same baseline query. Note the alert uses a 1h eval with a 3x burn threshold — we saw noisy spikes during last night's deploys. If numerator includes `status="503"` we might be double-counting transient reconnects. Suggest checking request labels and `deploy_id`.
jason: I can take a quick look and propose a tuning change. My suggestion: require sustained >3x for 30m within a 2h sliding window rather than firing on single-hour blips. Will add a suppress during scheduled deploy windows too.
liz: Alert id is `slo_burnrate_dedicated_pool_io_v2` — tagging @platform-team for approval if we lower sensitivity for prod-facing tenants. We need owner signoff before changing thresholds for paid customers.
sam: Another quick tweak: change the numerator to `slo_error_total{policy="dedicated-pool-io", severity!~"info|debug"}` to ignore non-critical errors. Also add this error-budget query to confirm remaining budget:
```
100 - (sum(rate(slo_error_total{policy="dedicated-pool-io"}[1h]))
/ sum(rate(slo_total_requests{policy="dedicated-pool-io"}[1h])) * 100)
```
maria: Runbook link for this SLO: https://confluence.redwood.internal/sre/slo-dedicated-pool-io-runbook — has triage steps and deploy suppression procedure. If it's deploy-related, mark as "deploy noise" and we can backfill a suppression window.
jason: I'll open a PR against alerting-config with the proposed window change + suppress rule and cc @platform-team. Assigning to myself and requesting review from sam and maria.
liz: Thanks. Can you also include a short note about how the burn rate is calculated so customers get consistent explanations? Put it in the PR description.
sam: Will do. Quick checklist for follow-up: 1) confirm owner, 2) run the error-budget query for last 7d, 3) update alert window + add deploy suppression, 4) add runbook note.
maria: If anyone needs a temporary suppression today while we roll the change, ping me and I'll approve for the maintenance window.
ops-bot: Deploy `dedicated-pool-io` finished at 2025-11-12T03:14:22Z (CI #4821) :white_check_mark:
liz: Okay leaving this thread open until PR merged and runbook updated. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
